title: Crude Oil Production (Monthly, PPAC)
description: India's monthly domestic crude oil production (ONGC, Oil India and private/joint-venture fields) in million tonnes from PPAC. Production has declined for over a decade and covers only about 12-15% of refinery crude needs, so the series matters mostly as an energy-security and import-dependence input.

qna.question: What does this measure?
qna.answer: Crude oil (including condensate) produced from Indian fields in the month, in million tonnes, as the 'Total crude oil' line of PPAC's production table (nomination blocks plus PSC/RSC regime).^A million tonnes of crude is about 7.3 million barrels.

qna.question: How should I read it?
qna.answer: Month-to-month changes are small and mostly reflect field maintenance and decline rates; use the YoY view. A flat or slowly falling line is the norm. Natural gas production is on the dashboard separately.

qna.question: Definitions, revisions and caveats
qna.answer: Figures are provisional and PPAC revises the latest months when companies report final numbers. The series starts in April 2022 (PPAC's production tables for earlier years use a different layout or sit behind its login). Month lengths matter: February is shorter, so seasonally unadjusted dips there are mechanical.
